raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

- Kimi-K3 serving on MI355X is decode-bound: AgentX interactivity is set by per-step latency at small batch sizes (M <= 64 tokens per MoE call).
- At that size each MoE layer runs three launches before the expert GEMMs: the radix-4 router, AITER `moe_sorting`, and the zeroing of the MoE output.
- The sort and the zeroing are short, latency-bound launches. K3 has 92 MoE layers, so they add 184 launches to every decode/verify step.
- The router launch already produces every route: its last CTA to finish can sort them, and each CTA can zero its own output row, so neither needs a separate launch.
- Goal: remove those 184 launches per step without changing routing or MoE output.

## Modifications

- `route_radix4_with_sort`: one launch routes, writes AITER's BM=16 MoE sort, and zeroes the MoE output.
- `srt/layers/moe/aiter_presort.py`: hands the sort to the next `fused_moe` via `register_presorted_moe` (ROCm/aiter#6484); AITER then skips `moe_sorting` and the zeroing.
- Scope and fallbacks:

| Condition | Path |
|---|---|
| 1 <= M <= 64, AITER has `register_presorted_moe` | fused route + sort |
| M > 64, or AITER without [#6484](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6484) | unfused router, as before |
| `SGLANG_SIMULATE_*_EXPERTS` set | unfused router |
| Tuned kernel for M is not BM=16 (Kimi-K3 table: M=3 only) | AITER logs once and sorts again |
| `expert_mask` set (EP) | AITER rejects the presort and sorts again |

- CUDA-graph padding rows are routed to expert 0 with weight 0, matching the HIP mask in `select_experts`.
- The host side checks sorted-row capacity and `reverse_sorted` length; the kernel writes them unchecked.
- No dependency on other SGLang PRs.

| New env var | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_RADIX4_FUSE_SORT` | on | `0` keeps the radix-4 router unfused |

## Accuracy Tests

Model eval: `sgl-eval 0.1.3 run gsm8k --load-preset-from-model-id moonshotai/Kimi-K3 --num-threads 32` (full 1319, temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, thinking on, reasoning_effort max).

| Fused sort | GSM8K | Truncated | Errors |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| on | 97.19% | 0 | 0 |
| off | 97.50% | 0 | 1 |

- The gap is 4 questions, within sampling noise (single-run stderr ~0.47 pp at temperature 1.0).
- Setup: 8x MI355X, `Kimi-K3-Quark-MXFP4-AttnFP8`, AgentX c16 recipe (cookbook MI35x TP8/DCP8 AITER + HiCache, DSpark block 4, decode graphs bs 1-32). Simulated acceptance (`SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN`) is off so outputs are real. Only `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_RADIX4_FUSE_SORT` differs.
- ROCm/aiter stack including [#6484](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6484).

Kernel tests (`test/registered/kernels/ops/moe/test_moe_route_radix4.py`, 69 passed on MI355X):

- Fused launch returns the same ids and weights as `route_radix4`, bit for bit.
- Sort checked entry by entry against the routes for M = 1 to 128, with padding rows, and across CUDA-graph replay.
- AITER's `match_presorted_moe` accepts the aux for M = 1, 12, 64.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Kimi-K3 AgentX, 8x MI355X, one 600 s screen per cell (InferenceX marks < 900 s as `submission_valid=false`). Same build; only `SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_RADIX4_FUSE_SORT` changes.

| Conc | tok/s/GPU off | on | Δ | P90 interactivity off | on | Δ | P90 TTFT ms off | on | Δ |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 4 | 1954 | 1886 | -3.5% | 131.1 | 134.4 | +2.6% | 991 | 1057 | +6.7% |
| 14 | 6157 | 6423 | +4.3% | 59.0 | 65.1 | +10.5% | 2036 | 1907 | -6.3% |
| 16 | 5898 | 6613 | +12.1% | 42.3 | 51.7 | +22.2% | 4734 | 2119 | -55.2% |
| 56 | 11441 | 13390 | +17.0% | 14.2 | 16.0 | +12.3% | 17367 | 4263 | -75.5% |

- P90 interactivity is higher at every concurrency; tok/s/GPU is higher at c14, c16, c56 and lower at c4.
- c4 tok/s is within the spread of earlier screens; c16 and c56 are not.
- A graph-capture probe saw the sort taken on all 8 ranks (e.g. M = 1, 5, 10, ..., 60 at c16/c56); the off arm registered none.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch:
@@ -3,23 +3,31 @@
 The ROCm counterpart to moe_route_radix, dispatched from
 biased_grouped_topk_gpu's aiter branch for covered inputs; anything else falls
 back to aiter. Kernel notes live in jit/csrc/moe/route_radix4_hip.cuh.
+
+route_radix4_with_sort also writes AITER's BM=16 MoE sort from the same launch,
+for a caller that hands it to AITER's fused_moe in place of moe_sorting.
 """
 
 from __future__ import annotations
 
 import logging
+from pathlib import Path
 from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Optional, Tuple
 
 import torch
 
 from sglang.kernels.arch import current_arch
-from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import cache_once, load_jit
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import cache_once, empty_sentinel, load_jit
 
 if TYPE_CHECKING:
     from tvm_ffi.module import Module
 
 _NUM_EXPERTS = 896
 _TOPK = 16
+_SORT_BLOCK_M = 16
+# Decode batch sizes; the leader CTA sorts every route alone, so the fused sort
+# stops paying off as M grows. Tested up to 128.
+FUSED_SORT_MAX_TOKENS = 64
 # One block per token, so the grid outgrows the machine somewhere past a
 # thousand tokens and the kernel turns throughput-bound, where spreading a token
 # over four waves is a cost rather than a win. Measured break-even is ~1.5k
@@ -29,6 +37,10 @@
 
 logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
 
+# Per (device, stream): CTAs elect the sort leader by counting arrivals on it,
+# so launches in flight on two streams must not share one.
+_ARRIVAL: dict[tuple[torch.device, int], torch.Tensor] = {}
+
 
 def supported_hardware() -> bool:
     """Whether this device is one the kernel targets, before asking whether it
@@ -43,10 +55,16 @@ def build() -> Module:
     return load_jit(
         "moe_route_radix4",
         cuda_files=["moe/route_radix4_hip.cuh"],
-        cuda_wrappers=[("run", "RouteRadix4Kernel::run")],
+        cuda_wrappers=[
+            ("run", "RouteRadix4Kernel::run"),
+            ("run_with_sort", "RouteRadix4SortKernel::run"),
+        ],
         # No fast-math: expert-id selection must stay comparable to aiter under
         # ties and NaN.
         extra_cuda_cflags=["-O3"],
+        extra_include_paths=[
+            str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "jit" / "csrc" / "moe")
+        ],
     )
 
 
@@ -133,3 +151,111 @@ def route_radix4(
         bool(renormalize),
     )
     return out_w, out_i
+
+
+def fused_sort_ready(device: torch.device) -> bool:
+    """Whether route_radix4_with_sort may launch on the current stream now.
+
+    Its arrival counter must start at zero, and a counter first allocated
+    during CUDA graph capture is only zeroed when that one graph replays.
+    """
+    key = (device, torch.cuda.current_stream(device).cuda_stream)
+    return key in _ARRIVAL or not torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing()
+
+
+def _arrival_counter(device: torch.device) -> torch.Tensor:
+    key = (device, torch.cuda.current_stream(device).cuda_stream)
+    counter = _ARRIVAL.get(key)
+    if counter is None:
+        if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "route_radix4_with_sort first ran on this stream during graph "
+                "capture; run it once eagerly on the capture stream first"
+            )
+        # The leader resets it to zero after every launch.
+        counter = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        _ARRIVAL[key] = counter
+    return counter
+
+
+def _sorted_capacity(n_tokens: int) -> int:
+    """AITER's moe_sorting capacity: every route, plus up to BM - 1 padding
+    rows for each expert that can be active."""
+    routes = n_tokens * _TOPK
+    active = min(_NUM_EXPERTS, routes)
+    blocks = (routes + active * (_SORT_BLOCK_M - 1) + _SORT_BLOCK_M - 1) // (
+        _SORT_BLOCK_M
+    )
+    return blocks * _SORT_BLOCK_M
+
+
+def route_radix4_with_sort(
+    scores: torch.Tensor,
+    bias: torch.Tensor,
+    topk: int,
+    renormalize: bool,
+    routed_scaling_factor: float,
+    *,
+    moe_buf: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    num_token_non_padded: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, dict]:
+    """route_radix4 plus AITER's BM=16 sort of its routes, in one launch.
+
+    Returns (weights, ids, aux), where aux is the dict AITER's
+    register_presorted_moe takes. A given moe_buf ([M, D] packed bf16, D a
+    multiple of 8) is zeroed in the same launch, and aux records it. Rows at or
+    past num_token_non_padded come out as expert 0 with weight 0, which is what
+    select_experts masks CUDA-graph padding rows to on HIP.
+    """
+    M = scores.shape[0]
+    device = scores.device
+    capacity = _sorted_capacity(M)
+    out_w = torch.empty((M, topk), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    out_i = torch.empty((M, topk), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    sorted_token_ids = torch.empty(capacity, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    sorted_expert_ids = torch.empty(
+        capacity // _SORT_BLOCK_M, dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+    )
+    sorted_weights = torch.empty(capacity, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    num_valid_ids = torch.empty(2, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    reverse_sorted = torch.empty(M * _TOPK, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    m_indices = torch.empty(capacity, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    build().run_with_sort(
+        scores,
+        bias,
+        out_w,
+        out_i,
+        _arrival_counter(device),
+        sorted_token_ids,
+        sorted_expert_ids,
+        sorted_weights,
+        num_valid_ids,
+        reverse_sorted,
+        m_indices,
+        moe_buf if moe_buf is not None else empty_sentinel(device, torch.bfloat16),
+        (
+            num_token_non_padded.to(torch.int32).reshape(1)
+            if num_token_non_padded is not None
+            else empty_sentinel(device, torch.int32)
+        ),
+        topk,
+        float(routed_scaling_factor),
+        bool(renormalize),
+    )
+    aux = {
+        "topk_ids_ptr": out_i.data_ptr(),
+        "topk_weights_ptr": out_w.data_ptr(),
+        "M": M,
+        "block_m": _SORT_BLOCK_M,
+        "num_experts": _NUM_EXPERTS,
+        "topk": _TOPK,
+        "sorted_token_ids": sorted_token_ids,
+        "sorted_weights": sorted_weights,
+        "sorted_expert_ids": sorted_expert_ids,
+        "num_valid_ids": num_valid_ids,
+        "m_indices": m_indices,
+        "reverse_sorted": reverse_sorted,
+        "moe_buf_zeroed": moe_buf is not None,
+        "moe_buf_ptr": moe_buf.data_ptr() if moe_buf is not None else 0,
+    }
+    return out_w, out_i, aux

@@ -1102,6 +1102,10 @@ class Envs:
     # Enable dual-stream MoE (shared experts vs routed experts) on the
     # ROCm/AITER path. Requires GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES>=5 to avoid HW-queue serialization.
     SGLANG_ROCM_USE_MULTI_STREAM = EnvBool(False)
+    # With the Kimi-K3 radix-4 router on (SGLANG_K3_RADIX4_TOPK), also emit
+    # AITER's BM=16 MoE sort from its launch for decode-sized M (needs
+    # ROCm/aiter#6484).
+    SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_RADIX4_FUSE_SORT = EnvBool(True)
     SGLANG_ROCM_SMALLM_ROUTER = EnvBool(True)
     SGLANG_ROCM_SMALLM_MOE = EnvBool(True)
     SGLANG_ROCM_SMALLM_FP8_PROJ = EnvBool(True)

@@ -0,0 +1,91 @@
+"""Hand AITER's fused_moe the BM=16 sort the radix-4 router writes on ROCm.
+
+At decode batch sizes AITER's fused_moe spends a launch on moe_sorting and
+another on zeroing its output. route_radix4_with_sort emits both from the
+routing launch; register_presorted_moe (ROCm/aiter#6484) hands that sort to the
+next fused_moe call, which uses it when the call's topk tensors, M and block_m
+match and ignores it otherwise. Without that AITER API the router runs unfused.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+from typing import Callable, Optional, Tuple
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import cache_once
+from sglang.kernels.ops.moe import moe_route_radix4
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.layers import zero_copy_context
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _registrar() -> Optional[Callable[[Optional[dict]], None]]:
+    try:
+        from aiter.fused_moe import register_presorted_moe
+    except ImportError:
+        return None
+    return register_presorted_moe
+
+
+def clear_registration() -> None:
+    """Drop a registration that no fused_moe consumed, as AITER's caller contract requires."""
+    registrar = _registrar()
+    if registrar is not None:
+        registrar(None)
+
+
+def enabled(scores: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+    return (
+        envs.SGLANG_OPT_HIP_K3_RADIX4_FUSE_SORT.get()
+        and 1 <= scores.shape[0] <= moe_route_radix4.FUSED_SORT_MAX_TOKENS
+        and _registrar() is not None
+        and moe_route_radix4.fused_sort_ready(scores.device)
+    )
+
+
+def _published_moe_output(n_tokens: int) -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
+    """The MoE output buffer the model published, when the kernel can zero it.
+
+    AITER only trusts the zeroing when this is also the output fused_moe gets.
+    """
+    out = zero_copy_context.ctx.moe_output
+    if (
+        out is not None
+        and out.dim() == 2
+        and out.shape[0] == n_tokens
+        and out.shape[1] % 8 == 0
+        and out.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and out.is_contiguous()
+        and out.data_ptr() % 16 == 0
+    ):
+        return out
+    return None
+
+
+def route_and_register(
+    scores: torch.Tensor,
+    bias: torch.Tensor,
+    topk: int,
+    renormalize: bool,
+    routed_scaling_factor: float,
+    num_token_non_padded: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Route with the fused sort and register it for the next fused_moe call.
+
+    Caller must have checked moe_route_radix4.covered() and enabled().
+    """
+    weights, ids, aux = moe_route_radix4.route_radix4_with_sort(
+        scores,
+        bias,

     )
 
 
+# ===== Fused BM=16 sort (route_radix4_with_sort) =====
+
+BM = 16
+MODEL_DIM = 3584
+
+
+def _payload_from_route(ids, weights):
+    bag = defaultdict(list)
+    m = ids.shape[0]
+    for token in range(m):
+        for slot in range(TOPK):
+            bag[int(ids[token, slot])].append(
+                (token, slot, float(weights[token, slot]))
+            )
+    for expert in bag:
+        bag[expert].sort()
+    return bag
+
+
+def _payload_from_sorted(
+    sorted_token_ids, sorted_weights, sorted_expert_ids, n_blocks, m
+):
+    bag = defaultdict(list)
+    for block in range(n_blocks):
+        expert = int(sorted_expert_ids[block])
+        start = block * BM
+        live = []
+        for row in range(BM):
+            packed = int(sorted_token_ids[start + row])
+            token = packed & 0x00FFFFFF
+            slot = (packed >> 24) & 0xFF
+            weight = float(sorted_weights[start + row])
+            if token == m:
+                assert weight == 0.0
+                continue
+            live.append((token, slot, weight))
+        if live:
+            bag[expert].extend(live)
+    for expert in bag:
+        bag[expert].sort()
+    return bag
+
+
+# 1 is the grid that skips the arrival handshake, 1..64 is what decode fuses,
+# and 128 is past the point where the leader can hold the pairs in registers and
+# has to stream them instead.

+def test_fused_sort_matches_route_and_layout(m):
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(7 + m)
+    scores = torch.randn(
+        (m, NUM_EXPERTS), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda", generator=generator
+    )
+    bias = torch.randn(
+        NUM_EXPERTS, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda", generator=generator
+    )
+    moe_buf = torch.ones((m, MODEL_DIM), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+
+    ref_w, ref_ids = moe_route_radix4.route_radix4(scores, bias, TOPK, True, 2.5)
+    w, ids, aux = moe_route_radix4.route_radix4_with_sort(
+        scores, bias, TOPK, True, 2.5, moe_buf=moe_buf
+    )
+
+    assert torch.equal(ids, ref_ids)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(w, ref_w, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    assert torch.count_nonzero(moe_buf).item() == 0
+    assert int(aux["num_valid_ids"][1]) == m
+
+    expected = _payload_from_route(ref_ids.cpu(), ref_w.cpu())
+    got = _payload_from_sorted(
+        aux["sorted_token_ids"].cpu(),
+        aux["sorted_weights"].cpu(),
+        aux["sorted_expert_ids"].cpu(),
+        int(aux["num_valid_ids"][0]) // BM,
+        m,
+    )
+    assert got.keys() == expected.keys()
+    for expert in expected:

+
+    used = int(aux["num_valid_ids"][0])
+    m_indices = aux["m_indices"].cpu()[:used]
+    packed = aux["sorted_token_ids"].cpu()[:used]

+    for token in range(m):

+            assert (packed_i & 0x00FFFFFF) == token

+def test_fused_sort_graph_replay():
+    """The leader resets the arrival counter after each launch; if it did not,
+    every replay after the first would elect no leader and skip the sort."""
+    m = 12
+    scores = torch.randn((m, NUM_EXPERTS), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    bias = torch.randn(NUM_EXPERTS, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    moe_buf = torch.ones((m, MODEL_DIM), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+    with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+        # Allocates this stream's arrival counter outside the capture.
+        moe_route_radix4.route_radix4_with_sort(scores, bias, TOPK, True, 2.5)
+    stream.synchronize()
+
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph, stream=stream):
+        w, ids, aux = moe_route_radix4.route_radix4_with_sort(

+            aux["sorted_weights"].cpu(),
+            aux["sorted_expert_ids"].cpu(),

+    """aux tells AITER the buffer was zeroed, so a buffer with the wrong row

+    m = 4
+    scores = torch.randn((m, NUM_EXPERTS), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    bias = torch.randn(NUM_EXPERTS, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")

+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("m", [1, 12, 64])

+    topk_weights_ptr, logs it once and sorts again, so a missing key only shows

+    scores = torch.randn((m, NUM_EXPERTS), dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    bias = torch.randn(NUM_EXPERTS, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    w, ids, aux = moe_route_radix4.route_radix4_with_sort(scores, bias, TOPK, True, 2.5)
+    assert (
+        match_presorted_moe(aux, ids, w, block_m=BM, num_experts=NUM_EXPERTS, topk=TOPK)
+        is aux
+    )
+
